summary: Twelve days to FreightWorks Expo. Retry queue and the duplicates root-cause fix are in production, the sync alert is live, and the Harbor QBR went well. The slot picker PR #241 awaits Sam's design review, which holds up the demo's screen 3. Pricing numbers, Pinecrest on Monday and Harbor follow-ups are open.

items.text: Retry queue (TW-104) is live in production. Arjun approved PR #238 and the duplicates root-cause fix (TW-103) has shipped.
Ridgeline (22% of revenue, health yellow, renews Nov 20) had repeated duplicates. The root-cause fix is now shipped, but renewal prep TW-113 is still todo, due Nov 13.
Nina's sync error-rate alert (TW-105) is live. Nina is on call this week; Arjun takes over Oct 26.
Harbor QBR is done. Dana's team liked the export fix and the time zone display. Renewal terms were shared at the QBR (TW-136 done). Harbor renews Oct 30.
Dana wants written notes from the QBR. TW-139 is owned by Jordan, due today, still todo.
Harbor asked at the QBR for a 4-week dock trend in the weekly report (TW-140, Sam) and for sync alerts in its ops channel (TW-142, Nina). Neither has a due date.
Slot picker build is up as PR #241. It cannot merge until Sam completes design review (TW-141). Leila needs the picker stable by Oct 28 for the booth tablet; TW-117 is due Oct 29.
Expo demo screen 3 (TW-119, due Oct 30) still waits for the slot picker build. Screens 1 and 2 are done. The dry run took 2:40 and Sam wants it under two minutes.
Sam's pricing page (TW-125) waits on final pricing numbers, which Maya promised by today. The one-pager must carry the same numbers as the pricing page; visitors will ask about pricing first.

Scoring API (TW-115, Arjun, due Oct 28) has ranking wired in. Nina's TW-138 (Coastal early-morning suggestions, due Oct 28) is in progress. New TW-143 (load test at 10x booth traffic, Nina) is due Oct 30.
API endpoint docs for design partners (TW-127, Arjun) are in progress, due Oct 26. Valley's data is flowing and its Smart Slots setup starts Monday. Coastal is live in staging.
Pinecrest live demo is Monday, Oct 26. Pinecrest is still unsigned as third design partner (TW-126, due Oct 30); signing would meet the launch goal.
Maya says the October investor update (TW-111, due today) is being sent today.
Maya says Expo invites go out today. Invite and lead list work (TW-122, Jordan) is due Oct 28. Booth 412 is confirmed.
Arjun holds the second backend candidate interview at 3pm today (TW-110).
